Name: Firefly Lamps
Author: tenthousandcats
TagLine: Use clusters of fireflies as lamps!
Description:
[align=center]
[If you like this mod, feel free to buy me a coffee! :)﻿](http://ko-fi.com/tadski)
This mod lets you use clusters of fireflies as light sources!
[/align]

Need more light but don't wanna install more lamp-posts? This mod is for you! The current version is a [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher) + [Content Patcher Animations](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853) mod that replaces the Wood and Iron Lamp-posts with a cluster of fireflies. This version is purely cosmetic, so the crafting requirements don't change. The fireflies are difficult to see in the crafting menu, so I recommend that you craft all your lamp-posts before installing/enabling this mod.

## Configuration
By default, this mod will replace both the Wood and Iron Lamp-posts with two different firefly animations: type `A` and type `B`. You can configure the mod to better suit your tastes:
* `WoodLampPost` sets the firefly lamp type for the Wood Lamp-post.
  * **Options:** `A`, `B`, `random`, `off`
  * **Default:** `A`
* `IronLampPost` sets the firefly lamp type for the Iron Lamp-post.
  * **Options:** `A`, `B`, `random`, `off`
  * **Default:** `B`

If you choose the `random` option, the firefly animation style will be chosen randomly each day.

If you want to use a different lamp-post replacement mod for either of the lamp-posts, be sure to set the corresponding lamp-post to `off` in this mod! For example, if you want to use a different Iron Lamp-post mod while keeping the firefly lamp for your Wood Lamp-post, set `IronLampPost` to `off`. (**Note:** Using the `off` option may make SMAPI display an error. This error will not affect your gameplay and can be safely ignored.)

## Future Development:
I'm working on a JA version of this mod. :)
